title: MLflow run tracking for data experiments
summary: Track parameters, metrics and artifacts so experiments can be reproduced and compared.

blocks.text: Track parameters, metrics and artifacts so experiments can be reproduced and compared.

items: Log configuration alongside metrics so a result is explainable later.
Use stable dataset/version identifiers in run metadata.
Do not treat tracking as model validation by itself.
Separate exploratory runs from production promotion rules.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
